name: approval-card
title: Approval Card
summary: Questions and actions an agent asks a person to approve before it goes on.
description: The decisions an agent asks for before it acts, so a person can approve or steer the work. Two modes. Questions: one at a time, the card's height follows the question while the stack slides, the step counter rolls, a single-choice pick auto-advances and a multi-select waits; a custom answer row, Previous/Next, a ghost Skip and an accent Continue; settles into an 'Answers sent' pill. Approve (the action prop): one action described (title, a sentence, the exact command, its details), an optional 'Always allow' checkbox, Deny and an accent Approve; settles into an 'Approved' (green) or 'Denied' (neutral) pill.

anatomy.description: data-state open | sent | closed; data-measured once the slide has measured the active question
role=status, sr-only; says the sent message when the answers go
surface, rounded-card, shadow-card
A Button (ghost sm square rounded muted), pinned top right; aria-label and our tooltip (Tooltip)
clips to the active question; its height animates to fit
every question stacked; translates to the active one
one question; data-active on the current one, the others are inert and transparent
the question is the heading

the answers. Single choice: a radio-group (data-layout="row", aria-label = the question) with its own highlight and its custom row. Multi-select: role=group (aria-label = the question) holding the highlight, checkbox rows (layout="row") and the custom row
multi-select only: the list's glide layer (`glideLayer` of `lib/glide.ts`) (a radio-group brings its own)
Approve mode, in the body: the question part as its heading (the action's title), then description, command and details, 8px apart
What the action does and why, ink-2
The exact command or call: inset fill, radius.control, mono xs on a 20px line, wraps anywhere, left to right in right-to-left pages
Facts about the action: a two-column grid, labels ink-2, values ink (mono when the detail says so), values wrap anywhere
One fact (display: contents, so its term and value sit in the grid)
Approve mode with alwaysAllow: the real Checkbox (sm, "Always allow"), marked data-approval-card="always", at the start of the footer where the pager sits in question mode

Question mode: the pager (orientation=vertical, reel, separator "/", unit "Question"; none for a single question, which needs no "1/1") and the actions, always at the end. Approve mode: the Always allow checkbox (or nothing) and the actions
Question mode: Skip (ghost sm: no fill at rest) and Continue / Send (accent sm). Approve mode: Deny (ghost sm) and Approve (accent sm)
The settled view: a status-pill and the reset button. Questions: "Answers sent" (green, mark). Approve: "Approved" or "Always allowed" (green, mark), "Denied" (neutral, dot)
Start over (questions) or Change (approve): the Button ghost sm muted, marked data-approval-card="reset"; reopens the card with nothing picked
Open approval: a Button (outline sm), marked data-approval-card="reopen"; shown when dismissed

questions.description: Question mode: the questions, one at a time. Leave it out with action.

action.ts: { title: string; description?: string; command?: string; details?: { label: string; value: string; mono?: boolean }[] }
action.description: Approve mode: the one action the agent asks to take. title is the heading, as a question ("Run the migration on Production?"); description says what it does in a sentence; command is the exact command or call; details are facts (Branch: main, Rows affected: 1,284), mono for code. Replaces the questions.

alwaysAllow.description: Approve mode: offer an "Always allow" checkbox beside Deny / Approve; the decision event says whether it was ticked.

state.description: open → sent after the last answer or the decision, closed after dismiss.

defaultAnswers.description: Answers to start with: question index → selected option indexes.

appear.description: Whether the card fades up when it mounts. Off by default: set it on the card your code adds live, never on one rendered from history or with the page (a mount is not an arrival). A reopened card fades up either way.

labels.description: { skip, continue, send, customPlaceholder, customLabel, sentMessage, startOver, reopen, dismiss, previous, next, pager (the pager's accessible name), unit (read before the pager's position); approve mode: approve, deny, alwaysAllow, approved, alwaysAllowed, denied, change }

events.submitted: (answers: Record<number, number[]>, custom: Record<number, string>) when the last question is answered
events.decision: Approve mode: (decision: 'approve' | 'deny', always: boolean) when Approve or Deny is pressed; always is true only for an approval with Always allow ticked

a11y.role: Questions: a radiogroup or a group of checkboxes per question. Approve: a heading, a description list and two buttons
keyboard: Single choice: one tab stop; ArrowUp / ArrowDown (and Left / Right) move and select; selecting from the keyboard never auto-advances
Multi-select: each checkbox is a tab stop; Space toggles
Enter on an answered question (on a choice or in the custom field) continues; on the last question it sends

Previous / Next question are the pager's labelled buttons (Enter / Space); with focus in the pager ArrowUp / ArrowDown (and Left / Right, Home / End) move between questions; at the ends the buttons are aria-disabled and keep focus; focus follows into the new question when it was inside the old one
Skip moves on (dismisses on the last question); Dismiss closes and focus moves to 'Open approval'
Approve mode: Tab reaches Always allow (Space toggles), Deny and Approve (Enter / Space decide); focus then moves to Change in the settled view
notes: Each question names its group (aria-label = the question). Inactive questions are inert.
The pager's position is a status region: 'Question n / N' is announced when the question changes; its rolling digits are aria-hidden.
Sending announces the sent message through role=status and moves focus to Start over.
Keyboard moves between questions are instant (kbd-instant on viewport, track, steps and the pager's reels).
Dismiss carries our tooltip with the text of its aria-label.

Approve mode: the decision is announced through the same role=status ("Approved", "Always allowed" or "Denied"). Nothing takes focus when the card appears: it never steals focus from what the person was typing.

motion: card: fndn-fade-up over duration.enter on reopen, and on mount only with appear
dismiss: with a pointer the card fades out (opacity only, duration.fast, data-leaving), then it is hidden; from the keyboard and under reduced motion it is hidden at once
question slide: viewport height + track translateY over duration.move, easing.out-strong; transitions, so rapid Next/Previous retarget
question crossfade: step opacity over duration.base (kept under reduced motion, where travel drops to 0)
counter: the pager's digit reel rolls over duration.move easing.out-strong (up going forward, down going back), with the slide
highlight: glides between rows over duration.move (radio-group's own layer, or the multi-select list's)
radio and check marks: drawn by radio-group and checkbox (fill leads, mark drawn, shorter exit)
single choice auto-advances 480ms after a pointer pick

after dismiss / send: the reopen button or the sent view fades in over duration.base where the card was (@starting-style, armed after the first render: never on first paint; instant from the keyboard)
sent pill: the status-pill's own mark pop-in over duration.popup when the sent view appears (never on first paint)
approve mode: nothing slides (one decision, no track); the card's arrival, dismissal and the settled view's fade are the question mode's
